title: Signal: Redirect to another host (Location header)
scope: Single redirect response: confirm the target host differs from the request host.
limitations: Single-response check: it cannot tell whether the target is attacker-controlled. Passive scope only; no redirect is followed. A protocol-relative target is also reported by DPK-DAST-050 (the owner-blocked protocol-relative rule) and a target that carries credentials is also reported by DPK-DAST-085; both pairs are recorded in docs/DAST_OVERLAP_LEDGER.json, and this rule answers the host-change question only.
fpNotes: Intentional redirects to a partner or identity provider are the common accepted case.
